label: Zyxel VMG4005-B50A VDSL2 35b single-line bridge modem
description: Pure VDSL2 bridge modem delivering 300 Mbit/s on a 35b single line (200 Mbit/s with 17a bonding) with ADSL2+ fallback, one RJ-11 line port and one 10/100/1000 Ethernet LAN port, transparently bridging PPPoE to the router behind it.
notes: Zyxel specs: 'Support VDSL profiles: 8a/b/c/d, 12a/b, 17a, and 35b', G.vector, G.INP; LAN 'One 10/100/1000 Mbps Ethernet RJ-45 ports'; bridge features 802.1D transparent bridging plus PPPoE/PPPoA, DHCP client/server/relay, CLI over SSH/telnet. Product page rates it 300 Mbps on 35b single line / 200 Mbps on 17a bonding. Line declared at the 300M 35b rung, LAN at 1G.
